message.content:
A medium‑sized apple (about 182 g) contains roughly **95 calories**.  
Calories vary with size:

| Size | Weight (g) | Calories |
|------|------------|----------|
| Small | ~149 | ~70 |
| Medium | ~182 | ~95 |
| Large | ~223 | ~115 |

These figures are averages; actual values can differ slightly depending on the variety and ripeness.
